This presentation — rapid, complete plant death of an individual plant at moderate growth stage — is most consistent with **Bacterial_stalk_rot** (Erwinia zeae), which causes sudden death of individual plants as the stalk tissue rots internally and the plant collapses from loss of vascular function.
